property_summary: For every input to initialize(..., _changeFee, ...), the reference contract stores changeFee equal to the exact _changeFee passed in (c.changeFee() == _changeFee); the mutant stores a shifted value so for some fuzzed _changeFee the stored value differs, violating this rule.
change_summary: Replace assignment of changeFee to store a right-shifted value (halves it) so initialized changeFee differs.
